text: On September 13, 2021, the Board of Directors of CreateTO reviewed a report entitled "City-Building Activities - Toronto Parking Authority Parking Facilities", from the Vice President, Portfolio Execution. This report included a Confidential Attachment that summarized the status of city-building activities involving Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) operated parking facilities. The purpose of the report was to provide an overall sense of the range of existing CreateTO projects that utilize current TPA operated parking facilities. The activities involving TPA operated parking facilities are primarily the outcome of previous City Council direction on advancing strategic programs (e.g. Housing Now, ModernTO, local Councillor-led initiatives, etc.), or in response to joint venture opportunities. As is consistent with the approach to date, Staff will advance analysis and strategic direction on…

The Board of Directors, CreateTO: 1. Confirmed its actions taken in closed session in issuing confidential instructions to staff. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 5, 2021) from the Vice President, Portfolio Execution, CreateTO remain confidential in its entirety, as it deals with proposed or pending acquisition(s) or disposition(s) of land by the City of Toronto.
